name: Meeting ROI Calculator
description: Calculate the labor cost of a meeting from attendees, compensation, overhead, duration and frequency, then compare the cost with estimated value created.
search_intent: Calculate meeting cost, annual meeting expense, break-even meeting value and estimated meeting ROI.
calculation: Loaded annual compensation = annual compensation × (1 + overhead / 100). Loaded hourly cost = loaded annual compensation ÷ working hours per year. Total attendee-hours = attendees × meeting duration ÷ 60. Meeting cost = loaded hourly cost × attendee-hours. Weekly cost = meeting cost × meetings per week. Annual meeting count = meetings per week × working weeks per year. Annual meeting cost = meeting cost × annual meeting count. Monthly equivalent = annual meeting cost ÷ 12. Break-even value = meeting cost. Net value = value created − meeting cost. ROI = ((value created − meeting cost) ÷ meeting cost) × 100. ROI is null when meeting cost is zero.
limitations: Value created is a subjective user-entered assumption.
Average compensation may hide significant differences among attendees.
Preparation, follow-up, travel, room, software and opportunity costs are not automatically modeled.
The output is a planning estimate rather than an accounting conclusion.
